protocol.timingBoundary: First source-chunk request through final CPU-readable PCM; excludes initialization, validation, hashing, WAV encoding and save. Optional articleCallPeakRssBytes spans the entire browser call including post-timer validation/export. Generation RSS uses timestamped samples inside browser generation start/end boundaries; it includes the owned Chrome process tree and browser baseline.

support.scope: Pinned Inflect Mini v3 checkpoint and the separately converted browser-port configuration
support.notes: The upstream checkpoint supports six English presets; this configuration bundles Cassidy speaker 2 only. Reference enrollment, non-speech events and 48 kHz enhancement are outside this profile. Browser synthesis is a distinct frontend/source-DSP port and failed the recorded strict native waveform gate.

cells.voice: Cassidy (synthetic preset; pinned Mini speaker 2, af_sarah donor bank; browser-port profile)
cells.precision: FP32 ONNX browser port; not exact native waveform parity

settings.configuration: inflect-mini-v3-browser-port; separate from official/native Inflect Mini v3 execution
settings.style: Pinned native length-indexed Cassidy style table; one row per phoneme count.
settings.seed: 42 + canonical chunk id + internal utterance index (uint32); Mulberry32 + Box-Muller excitation. Not PyTorch bitwise RNG parity.
settings.runtime: ONNX Runtime Web 1.23.2; pinned Inflect Mini v3 opset-17 FP32 graphs.
settings.frontend: Distinct browser-port configuration: pinned Inflect v3 numeric normalization and source-preserving 220-character split; Klein 0.2.0 browser G2P port with the pinned English lexicon and local browser eSpeak fallback. Native Mini uses Misaki 0.9.4 with bundled eSpeak; this frontend is an adaptation and has not been qualified for exact native-output parity. Checkpoint phoneme mapping rejects unknown symbols.
settings.chunking: Pinned native-v3 exact source-preserving 220-character internal splitter; 120 ms silence between generated internal utterances.
settings.waveform: Offline full-utterance graph execution; first PCM follows completion/readback of the first internal utterance. No trimming, fades, gain, or clipping.
settings.sourceFrontend: Standalone Float32 CPU harmonic source and source-STFT port; the waveform neural graph receives these features in a separate ONNX session. Strict native waveform parity remains failed and is reported in the pinned conversion artifact.

capability.description: Explicit one-thread ONNX Runtime Web WASM; an untimed Mini utterance completed.

notes: Capability checks run separately before timing. GPU dispatch does not imply GPU-exclusive execution.
